title: Lady Starts Crying After Refusing To Co-operate With Police
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On August 23rd, 2023. An officer conducted a traffic stop on a woman who was speeding and swerving in her lane. When the officer asked the lady to step out of the vehicle to test her level of sobriety, she did not comply, she said she did not know what was happening, even after the officer stated the reason multiple times. The woman eventually got out of the car but was still behaving erratically. She kept talking over the officer and refusing to do any field sobriety tests.  The woman even said she was from Argentina so she couldn't understand what the officer was saying, so a translator was brought to her, but even then she still failed to co-operate.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.

#news #police #arrest
